description: This file contains a C# class 'ImplicitSubscritionRecoverableStreamTestRunner' used for testing Orleans streaming scenarios, including methods for generating streams with errors and verifying counters.

classes.name: ImplicitSubscritionRecoverableStreamTestRunner
classes.description: A test runner class for Orleans streaming tests, handling stream generation, error scenarios, and verification of stream counters.

methods.name: Recoverable100EventStreamsWithTransientErrors
methods.description: Runs a test to generate 100 event streams with transient errors and verifies the counters.

methods.name: Recoverable100EventStreamsWith1NonTransientError
methods.description: Runs a test to generate 100 event streams with one non-transient error and verifies the counters.

methods.name: CheckCounters
methods.description: Checks the report counters for streams and verifies if they match expected values.
